newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CELTRON REVISES EARNINGS PROJECTIONS.
newsitem.headline: CELTRON REVISES EARNINGS PROJECTIONS.

text.p: Celtron Technologies Ltd said on Tuesday it had revised its earnings projections for the year to September 30 1997 and 1998.
It said it expected to report a loss of 8.8 cents a share in the year to September 30 1997 and a profit of 16.26 cents a share in the year to September 30 1998.
In February, the company forecast earnings of 13.04 cents in 1997 and 70.18 cents in 1998.
The company has previously cautioned it would not be able to achieve its prospectus forecasts when it reported a first half loss of 6.8 cents a share in May.

The company said on Tuesday the losses set out in the previous announcement reflected in the current accounts arose from the late launch of the Celtrack VMS System and the delayed launch of phones into the car rental market.
